description: This Java source file defines the class ExampleAppWidgetProvider, which extends AppWidgetProvider. It manages the lifecycle and behavior of an Android app widget, including updating widget views, handling deletion, enabling, and disabling the widget, as well as managing broadcast receivers for time zone changes. It also interacts with configuration activities and resources to dynamically update the widget UI.

classes.name: ExampleAppWidgetProvider
classes.description: An Android AppWidgetProvider subclass managing widget lifecycle events, updating views, and handling configuration and broadcast receiver registration.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Called to update the app widget instances with new remote views, utilizing stored preferences.

methods.name: onDeleted
methods.description: Handles widget deletion by removing associated preferences.

methods.name: onEnabled
methods.description: Handles first widget creation by enabling broadcast receivers for time zone and time changes.

methods.name: onDisabled
methods.description: Handles widget disable event by disabling broadcast receivers.

methods.name: updateAppWidget
methods.description: Constructs remote views, formats display text, and updates the widget UI.
